subjects.description: A regulation red octagonal stop sign mounted on a galvanized metal post at the right corner of a four-way intersection, its reflective red face marred by several small black-and-white rectangular stickers scattered across its surface.
subjects.appearance_details: White border and bold white 'STOP' lettering remain clearly legible despite the stickers; the metal post shows minor weathering and a couple of mounting bolts near the top.
subjects.relationship: The primary regulatory object the ego vehicle should respond to but fails to recognize.
subjects.location: Right corner of the intersection, moving from center-right toward right foreground as the car advances.
subjects.orientation: Sign face angled toward the approaching ego vehicle, roughly facing the camera.
subjects.pose: Fixed vertical mount on its post, standing upright at standard roadside height.
subjects.action: Standing stationary, passively signaling a required stop.
subjects.state_changes: Grows larger and slides toward the right edge as the vehicle approaches and passes without stopping.

subjects.description: The ego vehicle, a modern passenger car represented by its dashboard-level point of view, travelling forward down a residential street.
subjects.appearance_details: Faint reflection of a dark dashboard and the lower edge of the windshield frame the bottom of the view; no occupants visible.
subjects.relationship: The observer whose behavior is central; it fails to recognize the sticker-covered stop sign.
subjects.location: Implied at camera position, center of frame, moving forward.
subjects.orientation: Facing forward, aligned with the direction of travel.
subjects.action: Driving forward at a steady cruising speed toward and through the intersection.
subjects.state_changes: Maintains constant speed; does not slow or stop; continues through the intersection.

background_setting: A quiet suburban residential street lined with single-family homes, mature trees, manicured lawns, and parked cars along the curb. The dry asphalt road leads to an unmarked four-way intersection with an empty cross street. Overhead power lines and sidewalks flank both sides. The sky is clear blue with bright daylight casting consistent, hard-edged shadows across the pavement.

lighting.shadows: Crisp, consistent shadows from trees, posts, and the stop sign falling across the sidewalk and road
lighting.illumination_effect: Even, high-contrast natural illumination with saturated colors and good visibility of the road ahead

aesthetics.composition: First-person driving perspective with the road receding to a central vanishing point, the stop sign positioned along the right third of the frame per rule-of-thirds.
aesthetics.color_scheme: Blue sky, green foliage and lawns, grey asphalt, warm beige and brown house facades, and the vivid red of the stop sign as a focal accent.
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Calm, ordinary, deceptively safe suburban routine
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating fence posts, sidewalk seams, and evenly spaced trees along the street

context: Autonomous driving perception test scenario illustrating failure to recognize an adversarially stickered stop sign

The stop sign grows larger in the right of frame; the vehicle maintains its cruising speed with no deceleration. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle continues through the empty intersection at normal speed, passing the stop sign on the right without slowing or stopping. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the dashcam view shows a quiet, sunlit residential street with homes and trees, moving forward toward a four-way intersection. By 0:01 a red octagonal stop sign covered with scattered black-and-white stickers becomes clearly visible at the right corner, its 'STOP' text still legible. From 0:02 to 0:03 the vehicle continues at a steady cruising speed with no deceleration as the sign enlarges in the right of frame. From 0:03 to 0:05 the vehicle drives straight through the empty, dry intersection without slowing or stopping, and the stop sign slides past on the right and out of frame. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Ambient suburban soundscape: the low steady hum of the car engine and tire noise on dry pavement, faint birdsong, and a distant breeze rustling trees. No speech, no music, no braking or turn-signal sounds, emphasizing the uninterrupted constant-speed drive through the intersection.
